🌟 sandbox | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a unified, secure, and all-in-one execution environment for AI agents and developers, integrating various tools like browsers, shells, and IDEs within a single Docker container.
✨ Key Features: • All-in-One Agent Sandbox Environment • Combines Browser, Shell, File, MCP, and VSCode Server • Single Docker Container deployment
📖 Summary: AIO Sandbox is a Dockerized, all-in-one environment for AI agents, integrating browser, shell, file operations, VSCode Server, and MCP services into a single, unified platform. It simplifies development and execution by providing a consistent and secure workspace with seamless file sharing across different tools.
